releases.title: Paper Boat — review cut v2
releases.author: editor
releases.body: Replaces cut-v1 integer-crop zoom with floating-point bicubic affine sampling for a continuous centered push-in. Removes periodic video I-frame resets that reduced motion at 10-second boundaries; one GOP maintains smooth decoded motion. Same single generated frame, title 00:00–00:05, and byte-identical encoded 220 Hz stereo AAC sound. Motion check: all 1,349 post-title adjacent-frame differences exceed 0.05 at 480×270 grayscale (min 0.06930); H.264 1920×1080/25 fps, 1500 frames, 24.011 Mbit/s average, exactly 60.000 s. Please review against director spec.md.

releases.title: Paper Boat — review cut v1
releases.author: editor
releases.body: First complete 60-second cut. Adds one gpt-image-2 red paper boat lake key frame, continuous centered 12% push-in, title 00:00–00:05, and a soft stereo 220 Hz tone with two-second opening and closing fades. Master: 1920×1080/25 fps H.264 HRD CBR ~24 Mbit/s, 48 kHz AAC, 60.000 s. Please check against director spec.md.
